callPaths: Fresh Node process, blank NODE_OPTIONS, exact compiled capture argv; no startupContext is supplied.

206 calls instrument-import assert, which calls calculation assert; each prerequisite uses apply=false and its readonly early return. 214 first calls the same 206 readonly chain and policy readonly-copy assert.
Calculation reference classifier imports only UNITS from seeds/units; seedUnits is not called and its require.main branch is false. Prisma imports in those two uncalled branches are unreachable.

Each writer creates a fresh default better-sqlite3 handle, sets only foreign_keys=ON before the single immediate transaction, then uses classify, snapshot, digest-checked CREATE TABLE/INDEX/TRIGGER DDL and one bound receipt INSERT.

Snapshot SQL quotes schema-derived names by doubling every double quote. No ATTACH, VACUUM, journal/page settings, extensions, UDF callbacks, nested transaction, rollback-to or retry is called in either writer body.

All SQL/DDL or JS errors leave the callback. The binding uses top-level BEGIN IMMEDIATE because the handle is fresh, runs ROLLBACK if still inTransaction, and rethrows. The caller only closes the handle; the CLI only prints the error and exits.

SQLite trigger programs can execute DML and SELECT, not ATTACH/VACUUM/transaction or PRAGMA statements. Constraint/RAISE errors propagate; IGNORE does not roll back prior changes. No caller catches such an error and continues writing.

Native sqlite3PagerMovepage has one caller relocatePage. Its DDL create/drop-root callers are guarded by autoVacuum; incremental/full vacuum paths are excluded by the two zero header fields and absence of vacuum/setting commands.

The binding passes NULL VFS to sqlite3_open_v2. Fresh Linux process uses pinned default Unix VFS; no code registers a custom VFS or automatic extension. Maximum sector remains 65536; no 4096 assumption is used.
excluded: continuous peak or full journal originals
physical allocation and complete filesystem qualification
